esqlQuery.esql:
FROM security-firewall-logs-*
| WHERE device_vendor == "fortinet"
| WHERE message RLIKE ".*DoS.*"
| STATS attack_volume = COUNT(*) BY syslog_server
| WHERE attack_volume >= 10
| EVAL threat_level = "CRITICAL", attack_type = "DDoS Attack"

FROM security-windows-logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 1 HOUR
| WHERE event.id == "4688"
| WHERE message RLIKE ".*(mimikatz|sekurlsa|lsadump|kerberos::ptt|misc::skeleton).*"
| STATS
    mimikatz_executions = COUNT(*),
    unique_commands = COUNT_DISTINCT(message)
  BY syslog_server, user.name
| WHERE mimikatz_executions >= 1
| EVAL
    threat_level = "CRITICAL",
    attack_type = "Mimikatz Execution"
| SORT mimikatz_executions DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM security-windows-logs-*
| WHERE event.id == "7045"
| STATS service_installs = COUNT(*) BY syslog_server
| WHERE service_installs >= 1
| EVAL threat_level = "CRITICAL", attack_type = "Persistence Mechanism"

FROM security-privilege-logs-*
| WHERE event.action == "privilege_use"
| STATS escalation_attempts = COUNT(*) BY user.name, host.name
| WHERE escalation_attempts >= 1
| EVAL threat_level = "HIGH", attack_type = "Privilege Escalation"

FROM security-auth-logs-*, security-powershell-logs-*, security-privilege-logs-*
| WHERE event.action IN (
    "authentication_failure",
    "authentication_success",
    "process_start",
    "privilege_use"
)
| STATS
    attack_stages = COUNT_DISTINCT(event.action),
    total_events = COUNT(*)
    BY source.ip
| WHERE attack_stages >= 3
| EVAL threat_level = "CRITICAL", attack_type = "Multi-Stage APT"

FROM security-network-logs-*
| WHERE message RLIKE ".*CONFIG_I.*" OR message RLIKE ".*configured from.*"
| STATS config_changes = COUNT(*) BY syslog_server, `source.ip`
| WHERE config_changes >= 1
| EVAL threat_level = "HIGH", attack_type = "Config Change"

FROM security-ids-logs-*
| WHERE priority IN ("1", "2")
| STATS alert_count = COUNT(*) BY alert_name, `source.ip`
| WHERE alert_count >= 1
| EVAL threat_level = "CRITICAL", attack_type = "Intrusion Detected"

attributes.name: Windows User Added to Admin Group

esqlQuery.esql:
FROM security-windows-logs-*
| WHERE event.id IN ("4728", "4732", "4672")
| STATS escalation_count = COUNT(*) BY syslog_server, user.name
| WHERE escalation_count >= 1
| EVAL threat_level = "CRITICAL", attack_type = "Privilege Escalation"

FROM security-powershell-logs-*
| WHERE event.action=="process_start"
  AND host.name RLIKE ".*(embassy|foreign|diplomat).*"
  AND process.command_line RLIKE ".*DownloadString.*"
| STATS x=COUNT(*) BY source.ip
| WHERE x>=1
| EVAL threat_level="HIGH", attack_type="RedOctober Diplomatic Loader"

FROM security-windows-logs-*, security-firewall-logs-*, security-ids-logs-*
| STATS
    unique_devices = COUNT_DISTINCT(syslog_server),
    total_events = COUNT(*)
    BY `source.ip`
| WHERE unique_devices >= 2 OR total_events >= 20
| EVAL threat_level = "CRITICAL", attack_type = "Multi-Vector Attack"

FROM security-windows-logs-*
| WHERE event.id == "4625"
| STATS failed_attempts = COUNT(*) BY syslog_server, user.name, `source.ip`
| WHERE failed_attempts >= 5
| EVAL threat_level = "HIGH", attack_type = "Windows Brute Force"

FROM security-windows-logs-*
| WHERE event.id == "5140"
| STATS share_access_count = COUNT(*) BY syslog_server, `source.ip`, user.name
| WHERE share_access_count >= 3
| EVAL threat_level = "MEDIUM", attack_type = "Data Access"

FROM security-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 1 HOUR
| WHERE message RLIKE ".*(PsExec|WinRM|DCOM|Pivoted|SMB Lateral|RDP RemoteInteractive|wsmprovhost|WmiPrvSE|ADMIN\\$).*"
| STATS
    lateral_events = COUNT(*),
    unique_targets = COUNT_DISTINCT(syslog_server),
    techniques_used = COUNT_DISTINCT(event.id)
  BY user.name
| WHERE lateral_events >= 5
| EVAL
    threat_level = CASE(
        unique_targets >= 5, "CRITICAL",
        unique_targets >= 3, "HIGH",
        "MEDIUM"
    ),
    attack_type = "Lateral Movement"
| SORT lateral_events DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM security-firewall-logs-*
| WHERE syslog_server RLIKE ".*cisco-asa.*"
| WHERE message RLIKE ".*Deny.*"
| DISSECT message "%{} src %{}:%{source_ip}/%{} dst %{}"
| STATS blocked_attempts = COUNT(*) BY source_ip
| WHERE blocked_attempts >= 10
| EVAL threat_level = "HIGH", attack_type = "Port Scan"

attributes.name: SSH Brute Force on Network Device

esqlQuery.esql:
FROM security-auth-logs-*
| WHERE log_category == "authentication"
| WHERE message RLIKE ".*sshd.*Failed password.*"
| STATS ssh_failures = COUNT(*) BY `source.ip`, syslog_server
| WHERE ssh_failures >= 5
| EVAL threat_level = "HIGH", attack_type = "SSH Brute Force"

FROM security-auth-logs-*
| STATS
    unique_users = COUNT_DISTINCT(user.email),
    unique_actions = COUNT_DISTINCT(event.action),
    total_events = COUNT(*)
    BY source.ip
| WHERE (unique_users >= 3) OR (unique_actions >= 5) OR (total_events >= 20)
| EVAL threat_level = "MEDIUM", attack_type = "Suspicious IP Behavior"

FROM security-windows-logs-*
| WHERE event.id == "4688"
| WHERE event_message RLIKE ".*(-enc|-EncodedCommand|mimikatz|psexec|wmic|net user|sekurlsa).*"
| STATS malicious_processes = COUNT(*) BY syslog_server, user.name
| WHERE malicious_processes >= 1
| EVAL threat_level = "CRITICAL", attack_type = "Malicious Execution"

FROM security-lateral-logs-*
| WHERE event.action == "authentication_success"
| STATS unique_hosts = COUNT_DISTINCT(host.name) BY source.ip, user.name
| WHERE unique_hosts >= 2
| EVAL threat_level = "HIGH", attack_type = "Lateral Movement"

FROM security-network-logs-*
| WHERE source.ip LIKE "%"
| STATS
    downloads = COUNT(*)
  BY source.ip
| WHERE downloads >= 20
| EVAL
    threat_level = "MEDIUM",
    attack_type  = "StrongPity Watering-Hole Download Burst"

FROM security-powershell-logs-*
| WHERE event.action == "process_start"
| WHERE
  /* HTTP(S) download via PowerShell */
  process.command_line RLIKE ".*(Invoke-WebRequest|Invoke-RestMethod|DownloadString|Net.WebClient).*"
  AND process.command_line RLIKE ".*(http://|https://).*"
  /* Immediate execution / decoding – typical DarkHotel chain */
  AND process.command_line RLIKE ".*(IEX|Invoke-Expression|-enc|-EncodedCommand|FromBase64String).*"
| STATS
    c2_events = COUNT(*)
  BY source.ip, user.name
| WHERE c2_events >= 1
| EVAL threat_level = "HIGH",
      attack_type  = "DarkHotel PS C2"

FROM security-powershell-logs-*
| WHERE event.action=="process_start"
  AND process.command_line RLIKE ".*(-enc|EncodedCommand|FromBase64String).*"
| STATS x=COUNT(*) BY source.ip
| WHERE x>=1
| EVAL threat_level="HIGH", attack_type="APT3 Obfuscated PS"

FROM security-auth-logs-*
| WHERE event.action RLIKE ".*(authentication|login).*"
| STATS auth_count = COUNT(*) BY source.ip
| WHERE auth_count >= 20
| EVAL threat_level = "MEDIUM", attack_type = "High Frequency Auth"

FROM security-auth-logs-*
| WHERE event.action=="authentication_success"
  AND host.name RLIKE ".*(rtu|plc|control|ics).*"
| STATS x=COUNT(*) BY source.ip
| WHERE x>=1
| EVAL threat_level="CRITICAL", attack_type="Industroyer2 ICS Access"

FROM security-windows-logs-*
| WHERE event.id == "4776"
| STATS unique_hosts = COUNT_DISTINCT(syslog_server) BY user.name, `source.ip`
| WHERE unique_hosts >= 3
| EVAL threat_level = "HIGH", attack_type = "Lateral Movement"

FROM security-auth-logs-*
| STATS auth_count = COUNT(*) BY source.ip, user.email
| WHERE auth_count >= 10
| EVAL threat_level = "MEDIUM", attack_type = "High Volume Auth"

FROM security-windows-logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 6 HOURS
| WHERE event.id IN ("4768", "4624", "4672")
| WHERE message RLIKE ".*(krbtgt|TicketLifetime=.*[0-9]{4}h|Golden Ticket).*"
| STATS
    golden_ticket_events = COUNT(*)
  BY syslog_server, user.name
| WHERE golden_ticket_events >= 1
| EVAL
    threat_level = "CRITICAL",
    attack_type = "Golden Ticket (Persistence)"
| SORT golden_ticket_events DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM security-network-logs-*
| WHERE network.bytes_out > 1048576
| STATS total_bytes = SUM(network.bytes_out) BY source.ip, destination.ip
| EVAL total_data_mb = total_bytes / 1048576
| WHERE total_data_mb > 5
| EVAL threat_level = "MEDIUM", attack_type = "Large Data Transfer"

FROM security-firewall-logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 1 HOUR
| WHERE message RLIKE ".*445.*" OR message RLIKE ".*139.*"
| WHERE message RLIKE ".*Deny.*"
| DISSECT message "%{} src %{}:%{source_ip}/%{} dst %{}"
| STATS
    scan_attempts = COUNT(*)
  BY source_ip
| WHERE scan_attempts >= 5
| EVAL
    threat_level = "HIGH",
    attack_type = "EternalBlue Port Scan"
| SORT scan_attempts DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM security-auth-logs-*, security-powershell-logs-*, security-network-logs-*
| STATS
    unique_actions = COUNT_DISTINCT(event.action),
    total_events = COUNT(*)
    BY source.ip
| WHERE unique_actions >= 2 OR total_events >= 15
| EVAL threat_level = "HIGH", attack_type = "Multi-Vector Activity"

FROM security-powershell-logs-*
| WHERE event.action=="process_start"
  AND host.name RLIKE ".*(defence|mil|army|airforce|hq).*"
  AND process.command_line RLIKE ".*(DownloadString|IEX|-enc).*"
| STATS x=COUNT(*) BY source.ip
| WHERE x>=1
| EVAL threat_level="HIGH", attack_type="APT27 Defense PS"

FROM security-firewall-logs-*
| WHERE device_vendor == "paloalto"
| WHERE threat_name RLIKE ".*trojan.*" OR threat_name RLIKE ".*malware.*"
| STATS c2_attempts = COUNT(*) BY `source.ip`
| WHERE c2_attempts >= 1
| EVAL threat_level = "CRITICAL", attack_type = "C2 Communication"

FROM security-powershell-logs-*
| WHERE event.action == "process_start"
| WHERE process.command_line RLIKE ".*(-enc|-EncodedCommand|base64).*"
| STATS attack_count = COUNT(*) BY source.ip, user.name
| WHERE attack_count >= 1
| EVAL threat_level = "CRITICAL", attack_type = "PowerShell LOLBINS"

FROM security-auth-logs-*
| WHERE event.action == "authentication_failure" AND event.outcome == "failure"
| STATS failed_attempts = COUNT(*) BY source.ip, user.email
| WHERE failed_attempts >= 3
| EVAL threat_level = "HIGH", attack_type = "Brute Force"

params.subject: Security Alert: Brute force attempt detected on Sentinel

esqlQuery.esql:
FROM security-auth-logs-*
| WHERE event.action == "authentication_failure" AND event.outcome == "failure"
| STATS failed_attempts = COUNT(*) BY source.ip, user.email
| WHERE failed_attempts >= 3
| EVAL threat_level = "HIGH", attack_type = "Brute Force"

FROM security-auth-logs-*
| WHERE event.action=="authentication_success"
  AND host.name RLIKE ".*(gov|ministry|parliament|asean).*"
| STATS x=COUNT(*) BY source.ip
| WHERE x>=1
| EVAL threat_level="HIGH", attack_type="Naikon Gov Lateral"

FROM security-powershell-logs-*
| WHERE event.action=="process_start"
  AND host.name RLIKE ".*(embassy|consulate|diplomat).*"
  AND process.command_line RLIKE ".*(IEX|-enc|DownloadString).*"
| STATS x=COUNT(*) BY source.ip
| WHERE x>=1
| EVAL threat_level="HIGH", attack_type="APT15 Diplomatic PS"

FROM security-powershell-logs-*
| WHERE event.action == "process_start"
| WHERE
  process.command_line RLIKE ".*(http://|https://).*"
  AND process.command_line RLIKE ".*(blogspot|pastebin|github|gitlab|drive.google.com|docs.google.com|onedrive|mediafire|dropbox).*"
  AND process.command_line RLIKE ".*(IEX|Invoke-Expression|-enc|-EncodedCommand|FromBase64String).*"
| STATS
    c2_events   = COUNT(*),
    uniq_users  = COUNT_DISTINCT(user.name)
  BY source.ip
| WHERE c2_events >= 3 OR uniq_users >= 2
| EVAL
    threat_level = "CRITICAL",
    attack_type  = "Patchwork Multi-Stage C2 Campaign"

FROM security-powershell-logs-*
| WHERE event.action == "process_start"
| WHERE
  /* HTTP(S) download via PowerShell */
  process.command_line RLIKE ".*(http://|https://).*"
  AND process.command_line RLIKE ".*(Invoke-WebRequest|Invoke-RestMethod|DownloadString|Net.WebClient).*"
  /* Immediate execution / decoding – typical espionage loader behavior */
  AND process.command_line RLIKE ".*(IEX|Invoke-Expression|-enc|-EncodedCommand|FromBase64String).*"
| STATS
    c2_events = COUNT(*)
  BY source.ip, user.name
| WHERE c2_events >= 1
| EVAL
    threat_level = "HIGH",
    attack_type  = "GoldenJackal PS C2 Loader"

FROM security-network-logs-*
| STATS
    total_bytes_out = SUM(network.bytes_out)
  BY source.ip
| EVAL total_mb_out = total_bytes_out / 1048576
| WHERE total_mb_out >= 30
| EVAL threat_level = "HIGH",
      attack_type  = "DarkHotel Data Exfiltration"

FROM security-auth-logs-*
| WHERE event.action=="authentication_failure"
| STATS fails=COUNT(*) BY source.ip
| WHERE fails>=5
| EVAL threat_level="MEDIUM", attack_type="APT28 Credential Harvesting"

FROM security-auth-logs-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("authentication_success","remote_login","network_logon")
  AND host.name RLIKE ".*(msp|support|jump|remote).*"
  /* If user.email exists, use it; otherwise drop the user field entirely */
| STATS logons = COUNT(*) BY source.ip, host.name
| WHERE logons >= 1
| EVAL threat_level = "HIGH", attack_type = "APT10 MSP Lateral"

FROM security-*-logs-*
| WHERE event.action=="process_start"
  AND process.command_line RLIKE ".*(http://|https://).*"
  AND process.command_line RLIKE ".*(mobile|device|ios).*"
| STATS x=COUNT(*) BY source.ip
| WHERE x>=1
| EVAL threat_level="HIGH", attack_type="APT5 Watering Hole"

FROM security-*-logs-*
| WHERE event.action == "process_start"
| WHERE
    process.command_line RLIKE ".*(screenshot|capture|grab|record|keylog|screen).*"
    AND (
         process.command_line RLIKE ".*(powershell|wscript|cscript|rundll32|mshta).*"
        )
| STATS
    spy_hits = COUNT(*)
  BY source.ip, user.name, process.command_line
| WHERE spy_hits >= 1
| EVAL
    threat_level = "HIGH",
    attack_type  = "Carbanak Spy Module Execution"

FROM security-auth-logs-*
| WHERE event.action == "authentication_success"
  AND host.name RLIKE "(?i).*(router|gateway|soho|edge|fw|cpe).*"
| STATS logons = COUNT(*) BY source.ip, host.name
| WHERE logons >= 1
| EVAL threat_level = "HIGH", attack_type = "VPNFilter Router Access"

FROM security-powershell-logs-*
| WHERE event.action=="process_start"
  AND process.command_line RLIKE ".*(ShadowPad|FromBase64String|IEX).*"
| STATS x=COUNT(*) BY source.ip
| WHERE x>=1
| EVAL threat_level="CRITICAL", attack_type="APT41 ShadowPad Loader"

FROM security-auth-logs-*
| WHERE event.action=="authentication_success"
  AND host.name RLIKE ".*(router|fw|switch|core|edge).*"
| STATS x=COUNT(*) BY source.ip, host.name
| WHERE x>=1
| EVAL threat_level="HIGH", attack_type="BlackTech Device Access"

FROM security-powershell-logs-*
| WHERE event.action == "process_start"
| WHERE
  /* HTTP-based PowerShell downloader / C2 */
  process.command_line RLIKE ".*(Invoke-WebRequest|Invoke-RestMethod|DownloadString|Net.WebClient).*"
  AND process.command_line RLIKE ".*(http://|https://).*"
  /* Typical MuddyWater-style execution: IEX / encoded / obfuscated */
  AND process.command_line RLIKE ".*(IEX|Invoke-Expression|-enc|-EncodedCommand|FromBase64String).*"
| STATS
    c2_events = COUNT(*)
  BY source.ip, user.name
| WHERE c2_events >= 1
| EVAL
    threat_level = "HIGH",
    attack_type  = "MuddyWater PowGoop/PhonyC2 C2"

FROM security-windows-logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 1 HOUR
| WHERE event.id IN ("4624", "4648", "4672")
| WHERE message RLIKE ".*(LogonType=10|RemoteInteractive|mstsc\\.exe).*"
| STATS
    rdp_sessions = COUNT(*),
    unique_systems = COUNT_DISTINCT(syslog_server)
  BY user.name
| WHERE rdp_sessions >= 2
| EVAL
    threat_level = CASE(
        unique_systems >= 3, "CRITICAL",
        "HIGH"
    ),
    attack_type = "RDP Lateral Movement"
| SORT rdp_sessions DESC
| LIMIT 10

FROM security-auth-logs-*
| WHERE event.action=="authentication_success"
  AND host.name RLIKE ".*(scada|grid|ics|substation|energy).*"
| STATS x=COUNT(*) BY source.ip
| WHERE x>=1
| EVAL threat_level="HIGH", attack_type="Sandworm ICS Access"

FROM security-auth-logs-*
| WHERE event.action=="authentication_success"
  AND host.name RLIKE ".*(navy|marine|ship|port|dock).*"
| STATS x=COUNT(*) BY source.ip
| WHERE x>=1
| EVAL threat_level="HIGH", attack_type="APT40 Naval Targeting"
